reply: [{"query": "根据ICH E19，若在试验中需要从选择性安全性数据收集（selective safety data collection）转为全面安全性数据收集（comprehensive safety data collection），应满足哪些具体的触发标准或决策流程（reversion criteria）？", "query_en": "According to ICH E19, what specific trigger criteria or decision process should be used to determine when a trial should revert from selective safety data collection back to comprehensive safety data collection?", "topic": "转为全面收集的触发标准", "absence_terms": ["trigger", "threshold", "reversion criteria", "decision process"], "nearest_clause": {"page": 12, "text": "Concerns may emerge during the conduct of clinical trials utilising selective safety data collection that will require intensification of safety monitoring or reversion to comprehensive safety data collection."}, "rationale": "指南承认可能需要恢复至全面数据收集，但仅泛泛提及“可能出现担忧”，并未给出任何具体的触发指标、阈值或决策流程，而这是申办方在实施该方法时自然会追问的操作性问题。"}, {"query": "ICH E19要求研究者在实施选择性安全性数据收集前接受“适当培训”，该培训应包含哪些具体内容或达到什么标准？", "query_en": "ICH E19 states investigators should receive 'appropriate training' before implementing selective safety data collection; what specific content or standards should this training programme include?", "topic": "研究者培训内容要求", "absence_terms": ["training programme", "training content", "training curriculum"], "nearest_clause": {"page": 10, "text": "Given that investigators may not be familiar with selective safety data collection, CRFs should be well-designed, and investigators should receive appropriate training."}, "rationale": "文档提到研究者应接受“适当培训”，但作为一份实施性指南，未说明培训的具体内容、形式或考核标准，这是负责试验培训的部门自然会关心且期望在此指南中找到的问题，但文档并未提供。"}]
